extension.description: Automatically updates ratings for movies and TV shows in your library. Supports OMDb, TMDB and Trakt as rating sources. Enable in settings first after install.
extension.news: - 1.1.0: Add OMDb and TMDB as additional rating sources - 1.1.0: OMDb/TMDB API keys are now configured in the addon settings - 1.1.0: Use real IMDb vote count from OMDb for weighted averaging - 1.1.0: TMDB fallback for TV episodes that OMDb has no rating for - 1.1.0: Disable IMDb scraping (blocked by AWS WAF); improved source resilience
